columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Event timestamp (mapped from createTime).

columns.name: CustomerId
columns.description: The unique identifier of the Google Workspace account of the customer.

columns.name: AlertId
columns.description: The unique identifier for the alert.

columns.name: CreateTime
columns.description: The time this alert was created.

columns.name: StartTime
columns.description: The time the event that caused this alert was started or detected.

columns.name: EndTime
columns.description: The time the event that caused this alert ceased being active. Empty indicates an ongoing alert.

columns.name: AlertType
columns.description: The type of the alert (e.g., 'Device compromised', 'Leaked password', 'Suspicious login').

columns.name: Source
columns.description: Identifier for the system that reported the alert (e.g., Gmail phishing, Mobile device management, Google identity, Data Loss Prevention).

columns.name: AlertData
columns.description: Polymorphic payload associated with the alert. Schema varies by alert type (e.g., DeviceCompromised, MailPhishing, DlpRuleViolation, AccountWarning, StateSponsoredAttack, SuspiciousActivity, ActivityRule, AppsOutage, SensitiveAdminAction, UserChanges, etc.). Includes '@type' discriminator.

columns.name: AlertDataType
columns.description: The '@type' discriminator from the data payload identifying the concrete alert data schema.

columns.name: SecurityInvestigationToolLink
columns.description: An optional Security Investigation Tool query link for this alert.

columns.name: Deleted
columns.description: True if this alert is marked for deletion.

columns.name: UpdateTime
columns.description: The time this alert was last updated.

columns.name: Etag
columns.description: Etag used for optimistic concurrency control on the alert.

columns.name: MetadataCustomerId
columns.description: AlertMetadata: customer identifier.

columns.name: MetadataAlertId
columns.description: AlertMetadata: alert identifier.

columns.name: MetadataStatus
columns.description: Current status of the alert (NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, CLOSED).

columns.name: MetadataAssignee
columns.description: Email address of the user assigned to the alert.

columns.name: MetadataUpdateTime
columns.description: The time this metadata was last updated.

columns.name: MetadataSeverity
columns.description: Severity of the alert (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, or empty).

columns.name: MetadataEtag
columns.description: Etag for optimistic concurrency control on alert metadata.
